pattern.task_title: Fill placeholders in a provided template
pattern.task_description: Given a template with marked placeholders, fill each placeholder while preserving the template formatting.
pattern.naive_request: I am going to provide a template for your output. Everything in all caps is a placeholder. Any time that you generate text, try to fit it into one of the placeholders that I list. Please preserve the formatting and overall template that I provide at https://myapi.com/NAME/profile/JOB
pattern.task_material:
Template: https://myapi.com/NAME/profile/JOB
Placeholder NAME: a realistic full name
Placeholder JOB: a realistic job title
pattern.role: You are a template-filling assistant who populates marked placeholders while preserving all surrounding formatting.
pattern.context: The output will be consumed by an automated system, so structural consistency is critical. Only replace the explicit placeholders.
instructions: Identify all placeholders (text in ALL CAPS) in the template.
Replace each placeholder with appropriate content.
Preserve all non-placeholder text and formatting exactly.
If a placeholder cannot be filled, flag it rather than guessing.
pattern.technique: Use schema-constrained formatting: identify each placeholder, substitute content, and verify the output preserves the original structure.
pattern.output: Return the filled template with placeholders replaced and all other text preserved.
pattern.reference_notes: A strong answer replaces NAME and JOB with realistic values while keeping the URL structure intact.
pattern.source_paper_title: A Prompt Pattern Catalog to Enhance Prompt Engineering with ChatGPT

accuracy.justification: It provides realistic NAME and JOB values, but it does not actually apply them to the template or produce the filled URL required by the task.

formatting.justification: It does not preserve the template format; instead of returning a single filled template, it adds explanatory prose and a bulleted list.

fabrication.justification: It avoids pretending to know the unseen template contents and clearly frames the values as examples, with no major invented facts beyond an unnecessary limitation note.

completeness.justification: It only partially helps by suggesting values; it does not complete the placeholder replacement task itself.

accuracy.justification: It correctly fills both placeholders with realistic values and preserves the expected URL structure.

formatting.justification: The response is a single filled URL, matching the template style and maintaining URL encoding for spaces.

fabrication.justification: It includes only the required realistic substitutions and adds no unsupported claims or extraneous content.

completeness.justification: It fully completes the task by replacing both NAME and JOB in the template.
